Name: Pet Snow Leopard
Author: TheRightDaikiro
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This majestic feline is more than just a beautiful addition to your homestead. Your snow leopard will roam the farm, enjoy your affection, react to daily interactions, and slowly build a lasting friendship with you. Behind its calm, noble appearance is a playful companion ready to become part of your farming journey.

Unlike traditional farm animals, the snow leopard is purely a companion animal.
The mod supports multiple languages.

A huge thank you to everyone who helps bring this project to life.
Sprites and Icons:[b] MiPur[/b]
Coding: [b]TheRightDaikiro[/b]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Bring a touch of the high mountains to your farm with [b]Pet Snow Leopard[/b], a new adoptable companion for Stardew Valley.
